name: auto-validation-project-command-failure
config_toml:
model_provider = "harness"

[model_providers.harness]
name = "Harness"
base_url = "{responses_base_url}"
wire_api = "responses"
requires_openai_auth = false
supports_websockets = false

[validation.project_command]
command = ["/bin/sh", "-c", "printf 'project validation failed\n' >&2; exit 7"]
timeout_ms = 5000
